model.architecture: InternVL3.5-1B is a compact vision-language model: an InternViT vision encoder + pixel-shuffle + MLP projector feeding a Qwen3-0.6B language decoder (the newer Qwen3 backbone is what distinguishes it from the InternVL3-2B build, which used Qwen2.5-1.5B).

variants.quantization: Decoder Qwen3-0.6B int4 weights (symmetric, blockwise-32 + OCTAV optimal-clipping), input embedding INT8 (externalized section); vision encoder + pixel-shuffle + MLP projector int8 weights; integer compute

recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary: GPU 42.9 tok/s decode / 854.2 prefill, peak 628 MB, init 1.8 s (S4 GPU gate 2026-08-25, 1 run) against CPU 23.48-26.13 decode / 169.6-222.2 prefill, peak 1160 MB, init 1.1 s (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-05, 2 cold runs). Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win for gpu on decode (1.7x) and prefill

platform_notes: iPhone 17 Pro figures (~20 tok/s CPU, ~45 tok/s GPU, single-image VQA) are stated expectations carried from the InternVL3-2B build, not measurements of this build; the card recommends independent on-device measurement before quoting exact numbers.
Vision-only bundle (no audio tower): bring up the engine with the vision modality only (Modality.textImage / [.vision]); requesting the audio tower (.all) fails at session creation.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate prompt carries no image: it covers engine creation and the text path only; the vision path on the GPU is not measured there.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate: XNNPACK additionally takes 1 of the 4 nodes in `main`; the runtime accepts that split.
2026-08-28 start_token fix (metadata-only, weights unchanged): the literal start token "None" was removed. Accuracy figures on the card were measured on the previous file and not re-measured.

2026-08-30 tokenizer section replaced with the upstream tokenizer.json (weights unchanged): answers to prompts with accented letters/symbols/emoji can change; accuracy figures and any on-device rows were measured on the previous file; the on-device gate has not been re-run.

2026-08-31 chat template fix (metadata-only, weights unchanged): history turns with role 'assistant' are now accepted; single-turn renders, token ids, prefill counts and greedy answers are unchanged, so the card's numbers still describe this file.

measured.source: model card: Performance table (litert-lm benchmark, Apple M4 Max) (card retrieved 2026-09-05)
model card: Performance table (litert-lm benchmark, Apple M4 Max) (card retrieved 2026-09-05)

S4 GPU gate, 205-token benchmark, single run; full delegation (3840 ops across 3 subgraphs); generation gate answered the probe correctly. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is a GPU speed, not a measured win over CPU.

S7 Android backfill: same-device CPU control - identical binary, prompt file and flags, only --backend differs; 205-token prompt with --benchmark, 2 cold runs (compile/weight caches deleted between runs, device cooled below 42 C before each run); the GPU path does not run for this file on this handset, so this row has no GPU counterpart

known_issues: GPU (Metal) backend: a second image in the same conversation truncates the answer; ask about one image per chat. GPU-delegate-specific, not a model/bundle issue — on the CPU backend multi-image works; reproduces with FastVLM-0.5B, general to the runtime's GPU fast_vlm path.
